question: In the segment on everyday decisions our unconscious makes for us, a researcher in a blue T-shirt and glasses says 'thank God we don't have to be aware of all that stuff' about digestion. What institution is listed under her name in the on-screen caption?
notes: Lower-third caption 'NANCY KANWISHER, PhD / MIT McGOVERN INSTITUTE' visible ~489.5-494 s (checked 2 s strip). Short clip transcription confirmed she says the digestion line + 'thank God...'. Neither her name nor MIT/McGovern appears anywhere in the transcript.

question: During his interviews about split-brain research, what object sits on the table in front of Michael Gazzaniga?
notes: Caption 'MICHAEL GAZZANIGA, PhD / University of California, Santa Barbara' at ~1071-1074 s; a brain model on a white stand is on the table in every shot of his interview (e.g. 1071, 1090, 1115, 1145, 1204, 1234 s), each several seconds long. Transcript never mentions a brain model.

question: Before Heather sits down, Uri Maoz pulls a card out of an envelope and says 'let's see what this says.' What is printed on that card?
notes: Card held up at ~2222.5-2225 s (0.75 s strip) reads 'YOU WILL CHOOSE TO SIT HERE'. Transcript only has 'What this says. Oh my God.' (cue 74). A second card at ~2234.5-2236 s reads 'YOU WILL CHOOSE NOT TO SIT HERE' (also not read aloud).

question: When the neuroscientist who studies creativity is introduced, talking about playing the blues as a launchpad for improvisation, what musical instrument is he shown holding and playing?
notes: Charles Limb stands in a park holding a saxophone (wide shots ~2743-2751 s), then close-ups of him fingering/playing a gold saxophone ~2751-2758 s; his caption follows at ~2759 s. Transcript cue 91 mentions 'playing the blues' but never names an instrument.

question: In Michael Miller's two-handed drawing test, Heather is told to draw the shape on the left side of the screen with her left hand. What shape was that?
notes: Speech (cue 32, ~944-971 s) gives the rule: left-side shape with left hand, right-side shape with right hand, but never names the shapes. Screen at ~964.5-969 s shows a square on the left, a dot in the centre, and a circle on the right. Needs both: speech for which side, frame for the shape.
